description.value: Trek Bicycle Port Coquitlam is the largest Trek retailer in the region, offering full sales and service for bikes and e-bikes of all brands from their Westwood Street location. The shop is a one-stop destination for Trek and Bontrager products, custom Project One builds, and professional repair services with fast turnaround. Touring cyclists will find knowledgeable staff, free multi-point inspections, and local ride recommendations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM address and phone number exactly. Service capability evidence comes directly from the Trek Port Coquitlam store page and the /service/ subpage, which confirm walk-in (no appointment needed), 24-hour turnaround, and explicit e-bike service inclusion. No evidence exists on the site for pump availability, washrooms, DIY stand, rentals, bike boxes, or charging, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name is simply 'Trek' while the business operates as 'Trek Bicycle Port Coquitlam' per the website title and OSM operator/alt_name fields; the short OSM name may be ambiguous in a directory listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service Trek retail and repair shop serving all brands with walk-in, fast-turnaround service and e-bike expertise — directly useful to touring cyclists passing through Port Coquitlam.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: We offer fast, 24-hour turnaround on most service jobs so you're back out riding in no time.

Walk-in repairs.detail: No appointment needed. Stop by one of our bike service centers today, and our expert in-store technicians will have your ride rolling like new in no time at all.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Website states '24-hour service turnaround on most service jobs' and offers a complimentary demo bike if the 24-hour window is exceeded

E-bike service.detail: Store title is 'Bike & EBike Sales & Service'; service page states '24-hour service turnaround on bikes of any brand, including all e-bikes.'

wow_evidence: walk-in (no appointment needed), 24-hour turnaround, and explicit e-bike service inclusion
